roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/dashboard/) with this contract beside it, and the app-shell example it renders into components/patterns/app-shell/ (kept if you already have it). You own the copies: replace the demo data in dashboard-data.ts, pass your nav through shell, drop the cards you don't need, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Revenue overview for a subscription business inside the app-shell example (inset): a title with Tabs and Export, period / granularity / compare controls, a dismissible one-sentence summary, a selectable metric strip that picks the main chart's metric, a main LineChart with a labelled reference line (and the previous period dashed when compare is on), MRR movements, revenue by plan, retention by signup month, top plans, accounts that might churn, and a Needs attention rail. Every card has an Ask button that opens the work panel's Ask tab (kit Chat with a context chip); the panel's other tab is What changed.
useWhen: An overview page where a few headline numbers each open a closer look in one main chart
Recurring revenue, subscriptions or any metric set with this period against the last
A dashboard where people should be able to ask about one card without leaving the page
doNotUseWhen: One list of records to work through — start from list-detail
A page with one number or one chart — compose LineChart or Scoreboard directly
Live operations status that changes by the second — use the agent blocks (RunningNow, AgentMonitor)

metrics.note: DashboardMetric[]: { id, label, value, delta, deltaTone, sparkline, series: { current, previous }, reference: { value, label, highlight }, format, question }. Default: the demo data for period and granularity. An empty array is the no-data state: every card shows kit Empty.

selectedMetric.note: Controlled metric id shown in the main chart. Uncontrolled with defaultSelectedMetric (default mrr); onSelectedMetricChange(id) fires from the strip.

compare.note: Controlled: the previous period as a dashed series in the main chart. Uncontrolled with defaultCompare (default false); onCompareChange(compare) fires from the Switch.

period.note: Controlled period (Last 30 days, 3 months, 12 months). Uncontrolled with defaultPeriod (default 3m); onPeriodChange(period).

granularity.note: Controlled bucket size. Uncontrolled with defaultGranularity (default weekly); onGranularityChange(granularity). Options a period does not offer (monthly for 30 days, daily for 12 months) are disabled in the SegmentedControl, and a passed value that does not fit falls back.

insight.note: The one-sentence summary in a kit InsightCard (tone info) with Dismiss. Default: built from the data, key numbers in <strong>. null hides it; onInsightDismiss fires on Dismiss.

rail.note: Needs attention (failed payments, expiring cards) as a kit ListView in a Card. Wide: beside the charts in layout-split--primary, with the accounts table full width below. Narrow (the shell's --grid-breakpoint-md): under the table.

loading.note: Every card shows kit Skeleton in its place; the summary hides.

panel.note: Work panel start state: { defaultOpen, defaultTab: ask | changes, defaultMessages: ChatMessage[], defaultContext: string }. Closed on Ask by default.

shell.note: AppShellPattern props (nav, workspace, account, layout, className…) merged over the demo shell, so the page takes your app's nav. workPanel and children stay the pattern's.

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts, sparklines, metric tiles)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
Chart series take the chart palette (--chart-1 to --chart-6, set by the charts); status colours only where they mean something (past due, churn, a bad delta)
Every number uses tabular figures (the page root sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums)
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view; this page has none (Export is outline), so Chat's send stays solid
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Render inside a main landmark; nav stays reachable on small screens (the app shell's Drawer) and the work panel opens as its right Drawer when narrow
defaults: Shell: the app-shell example, layout inset, layout-shell--viewport, no top bar when wide; the work panel titled Assistant with Tabs Ask and What changed, closed
Header: PageHeader Revenue overview with Export (outline) and the panel toggle; Tabs Overview, Subscribers, Churn, Cohorts (only Overview is built)
Controls: period Select, granularity SegmentedControl, Compare to previous period Switch
Metric strip: Scoreboard appearance divided, selectable, five Scorecards with a delta Badge and a sparkline, in a Card
Main chart: LineChart area with the metric's reference line (target or last period's average) and points past it in the accent colour
Rows of two in layout-split: MRR movements (ComboChart stacked, net line) and Revenue by plan (LineChart stacked area); Retention by signup month (Heatmap) and Top plans (BarList in a Card)
Might churn this month: Table in a flush Card with chance, a status Badge and the next step; Ask and View all in the header
Each card: a title plus one plain line saying what question it answers

panel: Ask open with a context chip and suggestions

requirements: Metric strip: Scoreboard selectable is a radiogroup named Metric shown in the chart; one tab stop, arrow keys move and pick, Home and End jump; the chart title follows the pick
Each chart has a title, a one-line question as its description, a Table view, and the main chart a visually hidden summary sentence (start, end, how many points are past the reference)
Ask buttons are icon-only kit Buttons named Ask about <card>; the Chat composer is described by the context chip (Asking about <card> · <period>)
Status Badges carry text (Past due, Downgrade, At risk); colour is never the only signal; ListView dots are aria-hidden
The Compare Switch and the period Select have visible or accessible names; disabled granularity options stay in the group

doNot: Do not build a sparkline, metric tile, reference line or context chip locally; Scorecard sparkline, Scoreboard selectable, LineChart referenceLine and Chat context cover them
Do not colour chart series by status; losses in MRR movements are negative values, not red bars
Do not put more than five tiles in the metric strip
Do not add a second solid primary Button
Do not open a Modal for Ask; use the work panel (a right Drawer when narrow)
snippet:
<DashboardPattern
  shell={{ nav: { title: "Acme", items } }}
  defaultPeriod="3m"
  selectedMetric={metric}
  onSelectedMetricChange={setMetric}
  compare={compare}
  onCompareChange={setCompare}
/>

<DashboardPattern metrics={[]} />

<DashboardPattern panel={{ defaultOpen: true, defaultTab: "ask", defaultContext: "MRR · Last 3 months" }} />
